text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm spending the last night of<n>summer camp in the
common room,<n>when...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Open desk, open desk...
choice_data_list: Working on a side gig again tonight?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, heya-hey, Trainer! Yeah, I mean,<n>I'm just doing
as much as I can.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The more you get done, the more<n>these jobs pay
out!
choice_data_list: Want me to lend a hand?
Want me to lend a hand?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Nah, don't worry about it. Don't<n>you have
your own work to do,<n>Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. That look in your eye tells me<n>you're going to
be extra stubborn<n>today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right. I wanted to ask you about<n>my races
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
This'll give you something to keep<n>your hands
busy with while we<n>discuss stuff. Sound good?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taking the seat next to her, I start<n>carefully applying
labels to envelopes.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin is much more skilled with<n>her hands. As
she neatly places<n>sticker after sticker, the mountain
of<n>finished envelopes on the table<n>grows bigger and
bigger.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...So, Trainer. My new running style<n>still needs a lot
of work, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I can tell from the way it feels after a<n>run. At this
rate, when the race rolls<n>around, I'll just end up
exhausting all<n>my energy again.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Even though I know I have to hold<n>myself back.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm reminded of a comment made<n>about Ines
Fujin's running style<n>during her junior year—"Her
legs<n>can't keep up with her heart."

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In other words, she's been running<n>all this time on
pure feeling. But that<n>does mean her passion for
running<n>has always been extraordinarily high.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe suppressing those emotions<n>is a tougher
task for her than I'd<n>imagined.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. In your eyes, how am I<n>looking? What do I
need to do?
choice_data_list: Well, if you're finding it difficult to hold back...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt... Bzzzt...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's my phone. Be right back!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Whoosh! Flutter, flutter...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, the envelopes! Ahh, sorry! I'll<n>sort them out
after this call!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The neatly arranged stack of<n>envelopes topples as
she darts by,<n>scattering across the table.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Hello, is that you, Cassie? Is Polly<n>with you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: About that talk we had before—I'm<n>not budging.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want you both to chase your dreams<n>too. And I'm
going to do everything I<n>can to make sure you can
do that.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's not—that's not what I<n>mean! Don't
worry, I'm going to<n>keep running!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I know how tough it was for all of you<n>to support
me, and I'm not going to<n>let that support go to
waste.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But I won't let you two quit. If you<n>need extra help,
I'll make enough<n>money to hire someone!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to make it work—no matter<n>what Mom
and Dad say!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And if you're still worried, just wait<n>until the Kikuka
Sho! It won't be a<n>repeat of the Derby, I promise.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Click...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Phew...
